run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T01:01:42Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: frontend-proxy's error signal did deviate inside the window, but not in the shape the alert's 'since 01:01:42' implies. Its ingress error-span ratio sat at or below 0.3% from 00:43:30 to 01:04:00, then rose to 0.0702 at 01:05:30, 0.1437 at 01:06:00 and 0.0710 at 01:06:30, dropping back to at or below 0.005 from 01:07:00; its own 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase went from 0 to about 95.16 per 22m at 01:05:30. The frontend-proxy access logs show what the failed requests were: HTTP 500 with detail 'via_upstream' (upstream service frontend, pod IP 100.96.3.80, 21-byte body) on GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout beginning at 2026-11-17T01:04:16.371559Z, six seconds after the replacement cart container was started (01:04:14) and one second after the old cart pod was killed (01:04:15) by a cart Deployment rollout restart (new ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d carries kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T01:04:12Z; old ReplicaSet cart-755465879b scaled to 0). Only cart-dependent routes produced 500s; the rest of the 5xx lines were the pre-existing background of 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses at roughly one per 1-2 minutes from 00:43:56 onward, both before and after the burst. The cart container has neither a readiness probe nor a liveness probe, so the replacement pod joins the cart Service endpoints as soon as its container starts; the observed sequence is consistent with frontend's cart RPCs failing while the only cart pod was being replaced, which frontend turned into 500s and frontend-proxy recorded as error spans. That mechanism is stated as a hypothesis: cart's span rates stayed non-zero through the same minutes while the cart container logged nothing until 01:09:49, and the two sources disagree. Two other candidates are kept separately as a hypothesis and a rejected hypothesis: the enabled fault flag cartFailure (defaultVariant 'on', 'Fail cart service') in ConfigMap flagd-config, whose failure path matches but whose timing does not, and the background Envoy 503 connection terminations, which are not new in this window. The alert's own expression and its 01:01:42 onset could not be verified: no rule named RequestErrorRate is readable in this Prometheus (the rule queries returned no_data), and the annotation value 0.01111111111111111 cannot be reproduced from the trace metrics, which read 0.0002968 (ingress, 10m) and 0.0014969 (all spans, 30m) at that instant.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's ingress error-span ratio (ERROR ingress spans divided by all ingress spans, 2m range) was at or below 0.3% from 00:43:30 through 01:04:00, then rose to 0.07018867924528302 at 01:05:30, 0.1437403400309119 at 01:06:00, 0.0710059171597633 at 01:06:30, and fell back to at or below 0.005 from 01:07:00 onward.

frontend-proxy's own 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase was 0 at every 30s step from 00:50:00 to 01:04:30, then 95.16279069767442 per 22m at 01:05:30 and about 96-110 for the rest of the window through 01:22:00.

frontend-proxy access logs record HTTP 500 responses on 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart' and 'POST /api/checkout' with response flag '-' and detail 'via_upstream' (upstream service 'frontend', pod IP 100.96.3.80, 21-byte response body), first at 2026-11-17T01:04:16.371559Z and continuing through 2026-11-17T01:04:44.343034Z.

Before the 500 burst the only frontend-proxy 5xx lines were 503 UC 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on /api/products, /api/recommendations, /api/data and /api/cart at roughly one per 1-2 minutes, e.g. 00:43:56.804777Z, 00:45:12.569974Z, 00:47:16.515804Z, 00:48:19.017287Z, 00:49:32.509524Z, 00:50:46.801348Z, 00:52:37.51622Z, 01:00:29.251886Z and 01:02:29.245642Z.

Between 01:07:00 and 01:22:56 the only frontend-proxy 5xx lines were two 503 UC 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' entries on /api/products at 2026-11-17T01:08:48.894553Z and 2026-11-17T01:11:17.559247Z; no 500s appear after 01:04:44.

frontend's own ERROR spans were 0 at every 60s step from 00:44:00 through 01:05:00, non-zero (0.031113944444444448 to 0.13157894736842105 per second by operation) at the 01:06:00-01:08:00 steps, and 0 again from 01:09:00; the operations carrying errors were GET, GET /api/cart, POST, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect.

At the 01:06:00 and 01:07:00 steps the ERROR span rate by service was 2.5266666666666664 / 2.5266666666666664 for frontend and 1.24 / 1.2599999999999998 for frontend-proxy, while accounting, ad, fraud-detection, payment and recommendation were 0 or at most 0.011111111111111112 and the cart and checkout ERROR series begin only at 01:06:00 (so their prior state is unknown).

The cart Deployment was rolled out at 01:04:12Z: ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d exists with pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T01:04:12Z, Deployment cart emitted 'Scaled up replica set cart-84889c965d from 0 to 1' at 01:04:12 and 'Scaled down replica set cart-755465879b from 1 to 0' at 01:04:15, pod cart-755465879b-rh5r4 was Killed at 01:04:15 (ReplicaSet cart-755465879b SuccessfulDelete 'Deleted pod: cart-755465879b-rh5r4'), and pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz was Scheduled at 01:04:12 with its 'cart' container Created and Started at 01:04:14.

Old (cart-755465879b) and new (cart-84889c965d) cart ReplicaSet pod templates are identical in image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart, env (CART_PORT, ASPNETCORE_URLS, VALKEY_ADDR=valkey-cart:6379, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTEL_*), resources (limits cpu 45m / memory 165Mi) and port 8080; the only difference is the restartedAt annotation, and both declare readinessProbe: null and livenessProbe: null.

ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo declares the flag 'cartFailure' with state ENABLED, defaultVariant 'on' and description 'Fail cart service', while every other fault flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) has defaultVariant 'off'.

The cart container's application log contains no lines before 2026-11-17T01:09:49.008147Z (first line 'GetCartAsync called with userId=be85cc8a-d9de-11f0-b9b3-6e252e01a6fc'), with 3382 lines read from 01:09:49 to 01:14:50 for pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz.

cart's span-based rates show no sustained zero across the rollout: 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart' was 2.2444444444444443/s at 01:05:00, 0.25555555555555554/s at 01:06:00 and 2.4361247222222224/s at 01:06:30, with Redis spans (HGET, HMSET, EXPIRE) and flagd ResolveBoolean calls continuing throughout 01:04-01:09.

Pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8 is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and startTime 2026-11-17T00:33:03Z, and Deployment frontend shows generation 1 with observedGeneration 1; only the cart and flagd Deployments show generation 2.

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-v48vh has restartCount 1 with lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled and exit code 137, and its pod events show container 'fraud-detection' Created and Started at 2026-11-17T01:09:43Z.

The alert's stated current value 0.01111111111111111 is not reproducible from the trace-derived frontend-proxy metrics at the alert start instant 2026-11-17T01:01:42Z: the ingress-only 10m error ratio there was 0.0002967977969750824 and the all-span 30m error ratio was 0.001496915281096773.

Cause of the surge: the cart Deployment rollout restart at 01:04:12 removed the only cart pod from service while the replacement cart container (started 01:04:14, with no readiness probe, so it enters the cart Service endpoints immediately) was still starting, so frontend's cart RPCs failed and frontend answered GET/POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout with HTTP 500, which frontend-proxy recorded as error spans and 5xx access-log lines. The timing (first 500 at 01:04:16, six seconds after the new container start and one second after the old pod was killed) and the route specificity (only cart and checkout routes returned 500) support this, but cart's non-zero span rates weaken an outright-outage version.

Second candidate: the enabled fault flag 'cartFailure' (defaultVariant 'on', 'Fail cart service') in ConfigMap flagd-config, consumed by cart via FLAGD_HOST=flagd and FLAGD_PORT=8013, could be failing cart requests and thereby producing the cart-route 500s; it matches the failure path but not the timing, since there were no cart-route 500s before 01:04:16 or after 01:04:44, cart's ERROR series was 0 at every measured step from 01:06:00, and no cart error or exception log line matched, so it is not established as the cause of this burst.

Third candidate, for the alert firing at all: the recurring 503 UC 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses from frontend on /api/products, /api/recommendations and /api/data, present from the first available log at 00:43:56 through 01:11:17 at roughly one per 1-2 minutes, keep a '>0' error-rate condition satisfied independently of the 01:04-01:06 surge; this would explain a warning firing before the burst but not the burst itself.

cart was not continuously unavailable according to its span metrics (GetCart 2.2444444444444443/s at 01:05:00 and 2.4361247222222224/s at 01:06:30, Redis and flagd calls continuous), which conflicts with a simple 'cart unreachable for the whole burst' explanation and with the cart container's empty log until 01:09:49; the two sources disagree about whether cart served requests in 01:04-01:09.

frontend was not restarted or rolled: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8 has restartCount 0 and startTime 2026-11-17T00:33:03Z and Deployment frontend is generation 1 with observedGeneration 1, so a frontend crash or restart does not explain the 500s.

The other services that returned ERROR series in 00:45-01:22 (accounting, ad, fraud-detection, payment, recommendation, checkout and cart, the last two only from 01:06:00) stayed at 0 or at most 0.011111111111111112 error span rate, so no additional dependency shows its own error signal tied to this surge.

Rejected: that the 503 UC 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses are the deviation this alert reflects. They occur at comparable frequency from 00:43:56 (before any change in the window) through 01:11:17, including 01:00:29 and 01:02:29, whereas the only new 5xx class in the window is the 500 burst on cart and checkout routes at 01:04:16-01:04:44.

Add a readinessProbe (and a startupProbe) to the cart container so the replacement pod only receives traffic once the cart app answers, and use a RollingUpdate strategy with maxUnavailable: 0 on the cart Deployment so the old pod is removed only after the new one is ready; this removes the failure mode where a cart rollout or restart produces 500s at frontend-proxy.

Determine what issued the cart rollout restart at 2026-11-17T01:04:12Z (the restartedAt pod-template annotation) through cluster audit or change history, since the change_history integration is not available here, and confirm whether it was an operator remediation or an automated action.

Review flagd-config's cartFailure flag, currently ENABLED with defaultVariant 'on' and description 'Fail cart service', with the cart and flagd owners; if it is a demo or chaos switch, keep it 'off' in this environment so it cannot silently inject cart failures.

Re-work the RequestErrorRate alerting rule, which is not readable in this Prometheus and whose '> 0' condition is satisfied by the recurring low-frequency 503 UC connection terminations: separate Envoy upstream-connection resets from real 5xx and require a meaningful ratio over a stated window.
